name: Glass Bridge
desc:
Victory sits on the other side, but it's separated by a glass walkway!? Beware, every panel is a possible chance at falling to an untimely death... with conveniently-placed ragdoll physics and hilarious death noises. 

Heavily inspired by Netflix's Squid Game, and the story's minigame "Glass Bridge."

[🎤] Enhance your experience with voice chat!

Change Log (Version 1.5) - 4/2/2025

👨 Game is normal now! Did something happen while we were gone?
🎁 Hey exploiters! We got a present for you. Make sure you use it well.

[ALPHA]: More content is on the way. Join our socials for news updates or bug reports.
